[Gentlemen](../others.html#135)
Are you disposed to undertake the publication of four historical tales by [Madame Guizot de Witt](../persons.html#423), translated from MSS which have never yet appeared in France or England?[^1]
The subjects are the Countess of Montfort’s defence of Brittany, the childhood of Blaise Pascal and his sister, and some scenes from Madame de Sevigné’s life, and to these I could add Francis Xavier in Japan, translated by myself, but which has appeared in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) My name may be used as editor and I am very anxious for the publication as Mme de Witt wants means of assisting the sufferers in France
yours faithfully

C M Yonge

[^1]: The book was eventually published by Warne as Henriette Guizot de Witt, [Dames of High Estate](../books.html#100), the translations edited by Charlotte M.

Yonge (1871).
